description: Texas DOT (TxDOT) Work Zone Data Schema Version 2.0 is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) --- Recommended citation: "Texas Department of Transportation. (2020). Texas DOT (TxDOT) Work Zone Data Sample. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from http://doi.org/10.21949/1518704". This dataset provides archived lane closure occurrences within the Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) highway system in a tabular format. The ITS JPO has collections from 23 states including Texas covering various parts of the time period from 10/2019 to 08/2024 depending on when the feed was active. Coverage: Texas (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 31 columns, among them reduced_speed_limit, geometry_multipoint, geometry_linestring, lanes, types_of_work, update_date. The portal shows 2024-04-02 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) --- Recomm. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
